content.text:
`clone()` now gives a `Mesh`, `Line` or `Points` its own copy of the materials array. The material objects inside are still shared, as the issue asked. I haven't run any tests.

The fix is a one-line change in the `copy()` method of `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`, which `clone()` calls. When `material` is an array, it is now copied with `slice()`; a single material is still assigned by reference as before:

```js
this.material = Array.isArray( source.material ) ? source.material.slice() : source.material;
```

I left `Sprite` alone because it only ever holds one material, so there's no array to copy. `SkinnedMesh` gets the fix through `Mesh`.
